protocol.title: Electrochemiluminescence on Digital Microfluidics for microRNA Analysis
protocol.platform: DMF (digital microfluidics) with integrated ECL detection on ITO top-plate
protocol.objective: Magnetic particle-based oligonucleotide hybridization assay on DMF coupled to electrochemiluminescence (ECL) detection; discrimination of single-nucleotide mismatches; miRNA quantification in cancer cell lysates

top_plate.coating: Teflon-AF hydrophobic layer; apertures above each WE and CE/RE
top_plate.ito_remainder: functions as ground electrode for DMF droplet actuation

layers: Chromium array of DMF driving electrodes (yellow)

device.assembly: Top and bottom plates biased by AC voltages for droplet movement; DC applied between ITO WE and Ag/Au/ITO CE/RE via potentiostat for ECL
device.magnet: permanent magnet positioned below bottom plate for magnetic bead separation

magnetic_particles.product: Dynabeads M-280 Streptavidin (Invitrogen Dynal AS, Oslo, Norway)
magnetic_particles.probe_immobilization: ss-143 (21-mer deoxyribose analogue, biotin-conjugated) via avidin-biotin chemistry

variants.nc-145: fully non-complementary negative control (deoxyribose analogue of miRNA-145)

target_sequence.supplier: Bio Basic Canada Inc. (Markham, ON, Canada); HPLC-purified

hybridization_buffer.composition: 20 mM Tris-HCl, 0.2 M NaCl, 5 mM MgCl2

RuPhen3Cl2.function: ECL luminophore; intercalates into dsDNA (4 bp per ion); does not bind ssDNA or RNA

TPA.function: ECL co-reactant; TPA(+) radical reduces Ru(Phen)3(2+) to excited state emitting at ~610 nm

BWash_buffer.name: Binding and Washing buffer (B&W 1x)
BWash_buffer.composition: 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 1 mM EDTA, 2 M NaCl (diluted from 2x stock in DI water)
BWash_buffer.notes: Used for probe immobilization on beads (off-chip pre-assay step)

pluronic_additive.notes: Added to all solutions/suspensions prior to DMF use to reduce fouling of Teflon-AF surface

cell_lysate_samples.culture_media: DMEM + 100 U/mL penicillin G + 100 ug/mL streptomycin + 10% FBS, 37 C, 5% CO2
cell_lysate_samples.on_chip_dilution: 1:10 in sample dilution buffer (pH 8.0: Tris-base 7.7 mM, Tris-HCl 12.2 mM, NaCl 200 mM, MgCl2 5 mM, BSA 4% w/v, Pluronic L64 0.05% w/v)
cell_lysate_samples.cell_lysate_assay_modification: 5 unit droplets of magnetic particles dispensed instead of 3 (step 1)

pre_assay_steps.probe_immobilization: Off-chip: biotinylated ss-143 immobilized on Dynabeads M-280 Streptavidin via avidin-biotin chemistry (see supplementary information)

electrode_cleaning.method: Cathodic electrochemical cleaning of ITO WEs
electrode_cleaning.electrodes: ITO WE and Ag/Au/ITO CE/RE on DMF top-plate
electrode_cleaning.purpose: Remove adsorbed organic molecules and reduce oxide layer

steps.name: Magnetic particle dispense and merge
steps.notes: Paper M&M Sec 2.3: three unit droplets of magnetic particle suspension dispensed and merged. For cell lysate assays, five droplets used instead of three.

steps.name: Magnetic separation (initial bead pellet)
steps.notes: Permanent magnet below bottom plate immobilizes Dynabeads; supernatant (storage buffer) actuated away by electrode sequence. heat at 25c for 30s abstracts magnet hold.

steps.name: Target sequence dispense and hybridization
steps.operation: dispense x2, mix (merge), dispense pellet, mix (hybridization incubation)
steps.notes: Paper M&M Sec 2.3: two unit droplets of target sequence dispensed, merged, delivered to immobilized particles for resuspension and incubation for 15 min. ds-143 hybridizes to ss-143 probe on bead surface. pelletForHybrid re-dispense from MagneticParticles models bead pellet resuspension by incoming target droplet (magnet removed, electrode actuation drives resuspension).

steps.name: Magnetic separation (post-hybridization)
steps.notes: Removes unbound target sequence from supernatant.

steps.name: Hybridization buffer wash x4
steps.operation: dispense + mix (resuspend) + heat (magnet) + dispose; repeated 4 times
steps.notes: Paper M&M Sec 2.3: particles washed four times in series by re-suspending and mixing with one unit droplet of hybridization buffer followed by magnetic separation from supernatant.

steps.name: Ru(Phen)3Cl2 intercalation labeling
steps.operation: dispense x2, mix (merge), dispense pellet, mix (incubation), heat (magnet), dispose
steps.notes: Paper M&M Sec 2.3: two unit droplets of [Ru(Phen)3]Cl2 dispensed, merged, delivered to particles; resuspended and mixed for 2 min; particles separated from supernatant. Ru(Phen)3(2+) intercalates into dsDNA (4 bp per ion); ECL signal proportional to hybridized ds-143 on beads.

steps.name: PBS wash x2
steps.operation: dispense + mix (resuspend) + heat (magnet) + dispose; repeated 2 times
steps.notes: Paper M&M Sec 2.3: particles washed two times with 2 droplets of PBS as in step 3. Removes excess unbound Ru(Phen)3(2+).

steps.name: TPA co-reactant addition
steps.operation: dispense x2, mix (merge), dispense pellet, mix (incubation)
steps.notes: Paper M&M Sec 2.3: two droplets of TPA solution dispensed, merged, delivered to particles; re-suspended and mixed for 1 min. TPA is ECL co-reactant: TPA(+) radical formed on oxidation at ITO WE reduces Ru(Phen)3(2+) luminophore to excited state emitting at ~610 nm.

steps.name: ECL detection
steps.signal_metric: maximum ECL photon count within first 10 s (CV ~10%)
steps.notes: Paper M&M Sec 2.3 and 2.4: final droplet containing TPA and Ru(Phen)3(2+)-labeled DNA-modified particles actuated to ECL electrodes on top-plate. 1.5 V DC applied for 45 s; maximum luminescence within 10 s recorded. ECL signal decays over time (irreversible luminophore decomposition).

selectivity_results.conclusion: Single and double nucleotide mismatches distinguishable from fully complementary sequence. Non-complementary nc-145 indistinguishable from blank.
selectivity_results.mechanism: Mismatch reduces hybridization efficiency (steric limitations for surface-bound probes) and introduces structural distortions decreasing Ru(Phen)3(2+) intercalation level

cell_lysate_results.conclusion: MDA-MB-231 (more aggressive) shows significantly lower ECL signal than MCF-7 (less aggressive), consistent with down-regulation of miRNA-143 in more aggressive cancer phenotypes

compiler_notes.drain_lowering: drain in .bs false-branch is lowered to dispose() in IR -- known compiler bug; .bs source is correct
compiler_notes.true_branch_jump: bsbbif_2_t emits no unconditional jump in IR text -- known compiler limitation; DOT edge 2->4 resolves correctly

bioscript.duration_units: All durations in s or m (h token not supported by compiler)
